summary_1line: Bhishma explains to Duryodhana why he will not fight Shikhandin, recounting how he abducted the Kashi princesses for Vichitravirya and the events leading to Amba’s grievance.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma stands in his chariot carrying away the three jeweled princesses of Kashi while enraged kings surround him with raised weapons.
Bhishma showers arrows in all directions, cutting down the golden standards and chariots of the pursuing kings.
Princess Amba, bashful yet resolute, speaks to Bhishma in the palace, confessing her love for the king of Salwa.
